description: This file contains test cases for the NodeAppModel class, including deep link handling, message encoding/decoding, watch service interactions, and UI command processing. It focuses on testing various aspects of the node application's model layer in an iOS environment.

classes.name: MockWatchMessagingService
classes.description: A mock implementation of the WatchMessagingServicing protocol for testing watch messaging interactions.

classes.name: MockBootstrapNotificationCenter
classes.description: A mock implementation of NotificationCentering for testing notification authorization flow.

classes.name: NodeAppModelInvokeTests
